scope: 历史Silver同模型自动评审离线复算；不是人工准确率、不是P5 Gold重测
method: 独立标准库脚本；未导入/执行历史脚本；scores_recovered按case_id覆盖原始scores；所有历史源只读

successful_attempt_wall_ms.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, zero-based order statistics

retrieval_ms.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, zero-based order statistics

generation_ms.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, zero-based order statistics

intent_ms.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, zero-based order statistics

context_preprocessing_ms.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, zero-based order statistics

p5_readonly_crosscheck.scope: 只读取已有汇总并核对JSON/CSV一致；未执行检索、未重算或改写P5结果

historical_spot_check_40.selection: deterministic stratified risk-prioritized; not random and not a statistical accuracy sample
